observations.behavior: Adds `memo` to the root export of `BrowserTabStrip` and its internal implementation, while also changing the internal tab state construction.
observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce unnecessary re-renders of the browser tab strip, potentially improving responsiveness. The change also guards against a specific edge case where the Settings route could overwrite the last-known location for a pane, which could prevent a user from reopening Settings correctly after navigating away.

observations.behavior: Adds `memo` to the root export of `ChannelsSidebar` and its internal implementation, while also changing the internal feed ID extraction.
observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce unnecessary re-renders of the channel sidebar, potentially improving responsiveness. The change also guards against a specific edge case where the feed ID could not be extracted correctly, which could prevent the sidebar from displaying the correct feed.

observations.behavior: Adds `memo` to the root export of `NavRail` and its internal implementation, while also changing the internal feed ID extraction.
observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce unnecessary re-renders of the navigation rail, potentially improving responsiveness. The change also guards against a specific edge case where the feed ID could not be extracted correctly, which could prevent the navigation rail from displaying the correct feed.
